gaps.lead: You'll fail your exam if you don't revise.
gaps.explanation: unless + present simple = if you don't.

gaps.lead: After a year in Paris, the pace of life feels normal to her.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the pace of life in Paris.
gaps.explanation: get used to + noun/-ing = become accustomed to; present perfect for present result.

gaps.lead: There isn't a single clean cup left in the cupboard.
gaps.hint: run out of = have none left
gaps.explanation: run out of = have no more of something left.

gaps.lead: They say the new tunnel will halve journey times.
gaps.sentence: Journey times ___ by the new tunnel.
gaps.explanation: X is said to be + participle: reported statement, passive meaning.

gaps.lead: I'd prefer it if you arrived before eight.
gaps.explanation: would rather + subject + past simple for other people's actions.

gaps.lead: We couldn't see the lighthouse anywhere.
gaps.explanation: Fronted 'nowhere' forces inversion: Nowhere could we see…
